question: What is the esoteric significance attributed to the constant washing of the mouth?
premises: Washing of the mouth is done constantly
It is described as having gone upward of Brahman
The teaching is addressed to the beloved
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is identified as that which has gone upward of Brahman
uncertainties: The esoteric meaning of brahmaṇaḥ ūrddha gatam is highly compressed and context-dependent
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward from Brahman.
